verdict.rationale: Figma's docs confirm high-fidelity, interactive, no-code prototyping and dedicated animation/motion tooling ([figma-docs-16],[figma-docs-33],[figma-docs-28]), supporting the 'feel like the real product' goal, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents prototyping-specific conditional logic, variables-driven interactions, or scroll-triggered effects (these are general Figma features not detailed here). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of conditions/variables used within prototype interactions, scroll-effect prototyping, and independent hands-on validation of these advanced behaviors.
